caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of a goat standing on a rectangular base. The goat is predominantly gray, with finely shaded fur details giving a textured appearance to its body. Its horns are large, curved, and display a mix of brown, yellow, and black stripes, while the beard under its chin shares the same color pattern. The goat's ears are slightly pink inside, and its snout and hooves are rendered in gray tones consistent with the rest of its body. The composition is centered with the goat facing toward the left and is placed against a plain, beige background.
title: Goat
